explain.say: Imagine a family where the parent works hard every day, yet there is still not enough money for food and school shoes. How can that happen? Look at the board. It asks why some people live in poverty. Poverty means not having enough money or resources for basic needs, like food, a home and health care.

Hopeful fact: the share of people in extreme poverty has fallen a lot since 1990, thanks to jobs, schools and health care. Challenge: find out one thing your community does to help families in need.

faq.a: Poverty means not having enough money or resources to meet basic needs like food, clean water, a home, health care and education. Extreme poverty is when people live on less than about 3 US dollars a day, the World Bank's line since 2025.
Where there are few jobs, or jobs pay very little, people can work hard and still not earn enough. Steady, fairly paid work is one of the main ways families escape poverty.
asks: Tell me about few good jobs

faq.a: When someone is ill, they may not be able to work, and they may have to pay for medicine and care. Without health insurance or free health care, one illness can push a family into poverty.
asks: Why does being sick make people poor?

faq.q: How do war and disasters cause poverty?
faq.a: Wars, floods, droughts and earthquakes can destroy homes, farms, schools and businesses, and force people to flee, leaving them with nothing.
asks: Tell me about war or disaster
Why are countries at war poorer?

faq.q: How does unfair treatment cause poverty?
faq.a: When people are kept out of school, jobs, land or loans because of their gender, ethnic group, caste, disability or religion, they have fewer chances to earn a good living.

facts: In June 2025 the World Bank raised its international extreme poverty line to 3.00 US dollars a day (in 2021 prices).
Under the earlier 2.15-dollar line, the share of the world in extreme poverty fell from about 38 percent in 1990 to about 9 percent in 2019 (World Bank).

quiz.say: A hard-working farmer loses everything in a flood. Which cause of poverty is this?
quiz.show: A flood wiping out a farm is…
quiz.why: Disasters like floods can destroy livelihoods overnight, through no fault of the person.

wrong.1: The farmer worked hard; the flood caused the loss.
wrong.2: Too many jobs would help, not cause poverty.

quiz.say: What is the best summary of what causes poverty?
quiz.why: Jobs, health, education, disasters and unfair treatment often combine.

wrong.0: There is rarely just one cause.
wrong.2: Luck plays a part, but so do jobs, schools, health and fairness.
